item.title: The Game Awards 2025 live stream with multiple fighting game announcements incoming
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> The Game Awards 2025 is now underway, which you can watch with us below.</p> <p>It's almost the end of 2025 already, which means the time has come to hand out a bunch of awards, awkwardly chuckle at jokes and watch a ton of video game announcements.</p> <p>The Game Awards 2025 is slated to go down tonight, December 11, where multiple fighting game reveals have been promised — and more are likely to show up.</p>

item.title: Caitlyn announced for 2XKO as first champion for Season 1
item.description: <p>2XKO is up for the Best Fighting Game award at <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/game-awards-2025-announcements/">The Game Awards 2025</a> despite still technically being a beta, but that's about to change soon.</p> <p>Riot Games announced Caitlyn as the next new champion coming to 2XKO.</p>

item.title: Sneak peek of upcoming Street Fighter movie
item.description: <p>During <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/game-awards-2025-announcements/">The Game Awards 2025</a> a sneak peek for the upcoming Street Fighter film was shown. The film is set to be released in theaters on October 16, 2026.</p> <p>A <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/sep/04/street-fighter-film-cast-date/">rundown of the cast and which characters they're playing is available here</a>. item.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves wins Best Fighting Game at The Game Awards 2025
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/game-awards-2025-announcements/">The Game Awards 2025</a> went down last night with plenty of announcements and awards to go around.</p> <p>Although neither Kakeru nor Weibo|MenaRD unfortunately ended up winning the Best Esports Athlete at The Game Awards, there was still another category specifically for fighting games.</p>

item.title: Arcade1Up reportedly shutting down today
item.description: <p>Although the arcade era of the '90s is long gone at this point, Arcade1Up had stepped into the space to bring the experience home, but now that may be going away as well.</p> <p>Reports are circulating that Arcade1Up will be effectively closing up shop.</p>

item.title: One of the most absurd fighting games ever made is going to be at Evo Japan 2026 and I can't wait to see it on the big stage
item.description: <p>Earlier this week, we got the full lineup unveiling for both <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/09/evo-2026-game-lineup/">Evo 2026 and Evo Japan 2026</a>.</p> <p>The lineups share 9 games each, with 3 unique ones where Evo in Las Vegas will have BlazBlue: Central Fiction, Invincible VS and Rivals of Aether 2 as their exclusive games. item.title: Lagless Cup 2025 in Kyoto live stream ft. Gamera, Shio, ZangiefDream, Kasausagi, RQ, Tororo, Mabusin, Yamana, Abegen, Debgame, Desangel213 and more
item.description: <p>Lagless Cup 2025 in Kyoto is happening this weekend and if the name didn't spoil it for you already, it'll be happening in Kyoto, Japan.</p> <p>Notable participants include GS|Gamera, Shio, ZangiefDream, Kasausagi, IMM|RQ, IBSG|Tororo, Mabusin, Yamana, Geeks|Abegen, Debagame, Desangel213, Revo|Jing, Sanchi, Osakana-san, Barutorec, Tahichi and more.</p>

item.title: A.C.E 2025 live stream ft. Gobou, DarkNecro, Sanakan, A1r0ke, Monarch, Framework, Armperor, Llon_Nu13, Chocoservant, Cgm, Jubim and more
item.description: <p>A.C.E. 2025 is happening this weekend in Seoul, South Korea.</p> <p>Notable players participating include Gobou, ONi|DarkNecro, Sanakan, FC|A1r0ke, Kanme|Monarch, EGO|Framework, DNF|Armperor, EGO|Llon_Nu13, Chocoservant, Cgm, Jubim and more.</p>

item.title: Tournament organizers banned for collusion from Tekken World Tour by Bandai Namco
item.description: <p>The FGC is supposed to be all about community and comradery around fighting games as the name suggests, but bad actors can pop up any time to try and ruin everyone's fun.</p> <p>Bandai Namco announced they are banning some tournament organizers from the Tekken World Tour.</p>
